text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - Routing errors observed for Dedicated tenants in eu-west-2. Automatic failover attempted and partially succeeded. Paging on-call.
ashley (oncall): picking this up. initial symptoms?
mike (sre): getting logs now. we see 502s from frontend -> router-proxy on dedicated pools, KV cache miss spikes. might be network partition to dedicated GPUs.
jordan (acct-mgr): heads-up: CalyxBank and MeridianPay are on Dedicated in eu-west-2. high-touch customers. need tailored comms asap. who can own outreach?
sylvie (support): I can pull contact list. Jordan, do you want email + phone or just phone for CalyxBank? I have their escalation matrix.
jordan (acct-mgr): both please. CalyxBank wants direct phone and Slack, MeridianPay prefers email + account portal update.
ashley (oncall): ops-pager-bot, send page to infra-rotation for 10min. also add mike.
ops-pager-bot: Paging infra-rotation: P1 assigned to ashley, escalation to mike in 5 minutes. :telephone_receiver:
ashley (oncall): quick mitigation plan: 1) verify failover to standby region for non-dedicated traffic 2) attempt router-proxy restart on affected shard 3) if restart fails, re-route CalyxBank to compatible dedicated pool in eu-central-1 with manual override. any objections?
mike (sre): no objections. I'll target a rolling restart of router-proxy on nodes 3-6 to avoid full disruption. if restarts fail, prepare manual routing plan.
rachel (status): drafting status page message. proposed copy:

```
Incident: Routing errors affecting dedicated customers in eu-west-2
Impact: Some dedicated tenants may experience 502/timeout errors for inference requests.
Mitigation: Engineers are performing rolling restarts of routing components and may temporarily re-route traffic to standby capacity. We will provide updates every 15 minutes.
ETA: 30-60 minutes for root cause and stable mitigation.
```

approve for post?
jordan (acct-mgr): can we add a line for affected customers: CalyxBank (highly impacted) and MeridianPay (possible intermittent errors). include account reps contact info.
sylvie (support): Adding contact list now:
- CalyxBank: eng-ops@calyxbk.com, oncall +1-555-0123, rep: Jordan
- MeridianPay: support@meridianpay.com, rep: Priya (CC: jordan@redwood.com)

I'll also attach the calendar escalation numbers.
ashley (oncall): mike, status on restart?
mike (sre): restarted router-proxy on node-3 and node-4. node-5 restart failed (OOM on container). rolling back node-5 to previous image and bringing up extra capacity from warm pool.
ashley (oncall): moving to manual routing for CalyxBank now. Jordan: recommended customer notice below — please review/approve quickly.

```
Subject: Immediate update from Redwood Inference — CalyxBank routing impact

Hi <CalyxBank Eng Ops>,

We’re investigating a routing incident in eu-west-2 that is impacting some dedicated tenants, including your instance. Our engineers are performing rolling restarts and a manual reroute to standby capacity to restore service. Expected restoration window: 30-60 minutes. We will post an update on status.redwood.ai and send another update within 15 minutes. For urgent escalation: Jordan (Account Lead) +1-555-9876 or slack @jordan.

We apologize for the disruption and are prioritizing your traffic.

— Redwood Inference Ops
```

jordan (acct-mgr): small edit: replace "Expected restoration window" with "Estimated time to restore service" and add our phone number. after that, send.
rachel (status): approved copy for status page and page now scheduled. Posting update and marking "investigating".
rachel (status): POSTED to status page: Incident created and investigating. (include: CalyxBank, MeridianPay as affected)
sylvie (support): emailed CalyxBank support+oncall with approved template and phone numbers. MeridianPay outbound email queued.
mike (sre): node-5 rollback successful, router-proxy process stable. seeing error rate drop ~70% on affected shard. KV cache warming underway.
ashley (oncall): good. continue monitoring. schedule 15-min check-in then handoff to night oncall if not resolved. Jordan — send the tailored text for CalyxBank if you want me to include in the email thread.
jordan (acct-mgr): sent the quick SMS template to CalyxBank ops. they confirmed receiving and asked for phone bridge if issue persists.
incident-bot: Note: This thread will be used for customer-tailored comms. Use channel #incidents for tech, #cust-comms for customer-facing drafts.
ashley (oncall): ACTIONS:
- mike: continue restart/warm-pool + report latencies (next update +10m)
- sylvie: maintain outbound contact log and escalate to on-call rep if bridge requested
- jordan: approve final email/SMS + coordinate phone bridge if needed
- rachel: keep status page updated (every 15m)

mike (sre): observed transient increased latency for live requests; P50 unaffected, P95 improved after restarts. will post metrics snapshot.

rachel (status): posted update: mitigation in progress, partial recovery observed. Next update in 15 minutes.

sylvie (support): CalyxBank asked for a post-incident SLA credit request form — Jordan, can you approve we send standard credit form after resolution?
jordan (acct-mgr): yes, standard SLA credit form ok. we'll include note and assign follow-up.

ashley (oncall): logging this for the postmortem: impact list, timeline, customer comms timeline, manual routing decisions, warm pool use. tagging eng-oncall for RCA.

ops-pager-bot: Escalation timer: 10 minutes remaining to auto-escalate to SRE lead.

mike (sre): posting metrics snapshot: 502 rate by shard: affected shard 3 -> 0.6% -> 0.18% after restart. continuing observation.

ashley (oncall): if stable at next check, prepare to handoff to night oncall at +45m with runbook and comms log.

jordan (acct-mgr): thanks team. I'll follow up with CalyxBank and MeridianPay after the next update. please copy me on the status page snapshot and email threads. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Thread closed for new incident pages. Continue updates in this thread until resolved.
